# gittr

> Nostr git hosting on https://gittr.space — repositories, issues, pull requests, Pages, apps, and Lightning bounties.

gittr is a web forge for git on Nostr (NIP-34 / GRASP). Repo names, issues, and PRs are signed events on relays. Git objects live on clone hosts such as git.gittr.space.

## Product

- Home: https://gittr.space
- What is Nostr git: https://gittr.space/nostr-git
- Explore public repos: https://gittr.space/explore
- Nostr apps catalog: https://gittr.space/apps
- Published Pages: https://gittr.space/pages
- Create or import a repo: https://gittr.space/new
- Help: https://gittr.space/help
- Lightning bounties: https://gittr.space/bounty-hunt
- Legal: https://gittr.space/legal

## Related hosts

- Git SSH/HTTPS: https://git.gittr.space
- Pages: https://pages.gittr.space
- Relay: wss://relay.gittr.space
- Docs hub (Pages): see Help → gittr-docu

## Protocol

- NIP-34 git collaboration (kinds 30617 / 30618, issues, PRs)
- GRASP clone hosts
- NIP-82 software / Zapstore-style apps
- gittr Pages / nsite for static sites
